specula.definition:
n a mirror (especially one made of polished metal) for use in an optical instrument
n a medical instrument for dilating a bodily passage or cavity in order to examine the interior
specula.translation: n. 反射镜, 子宫镜

specular.definition: s capable of reflecting light like a mirror
specular.translation: a. 镜子的, 镜子一般的, 会反射的

specularity.translation: n. specular（镜子的）的变形; 高光；镜面反射；单向反射性

speculate.definition:
v. to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
v. talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion
v. invest at a risk
speculate.translation:
vi. 深思, 推测, 投机
[经] 投机

speculated.translation: v. 思索, 猜测, 推测( speculate的过去式和过去分词 ); 投机

speculates.definition:
v to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
v talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion
v reflect deeply on a subject
v invest at a risk
speculates.translation: v. 思索, 猜测, 推测( speculate的第三人称单数 ); 投机

speculating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Speculate
speculating.translation: v. 思索, 猜测, 推测( speculate的现在分词 ); 投机

speculation.definition:
n. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)
n. an investment that is very risky but could yield great profits
speculation.translation:
n. 沉思, 推测, 投机
[经] 投机交易, 买空卖空

speculations.definition:
n. a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence
n. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)
n. an investment that is very risky but could yield great profits
speculations.translation: n. 投机买卖( speculation的复数形式 ); 思考; 投机活动; 推断

speculative.definition:
s not financially safe or secure
s not based on fact or investigation
s showing curiosity
speculative.translation:
a. 思索性的, 投机的, 推测的
[经] 投机的, 冒险的

speculative investment.translation: [经] 投机投资, 冒险的投资

speculative leaders.translation: [经] 乘机出售特别廉价的商品

speculative profiteer.translation: [法] 投机买卖获暴利者, 暴发户

speculatively.definition: r. with speculation; in a speculative manner
speculatively.translation: adv. 思考地, 思索地; 投机地

speculativeness.translation: n. 思考，思索; 投机

speculator.definition:
n. someone who makes conjectures without knowing the facts
n. someone who risks losses for the possibility of considerable gains
speculator.translation:
n. 投机者, 投机商人, 思索者
[经] 投机买卖者, 投机商

speculators.definition:
n. someone who makes conjectures without knowing the facts
n. someone who risks losses for the possibility of considerable gains
speculators.translation: n. 投机倒把者, 投机商( speculator的复数形式 )

speculatory.definition:
a. Intended or adapted for viewing or espying; having
   oversight.
a. Exercising speculation; speculative.

speculum.definition:
n. a mirror (especially one made of polished metal) for use in an optical instrument
n. a medical instrument for dilating a bodily passage or cavity in order to examine the interior
speculum.translation:
n. 金属镜, 反射镜, 扩张器
[医] 窥器, 张开器; 透明隔; 翼斑, 翼镜(鸟)

speculums.translation: 金属镜, 诊视器, 反射镜( speculum的名词复数 )
